title: FurnaceEditor
description: A collection of powerful in-game editors to manage crafting and smelting recipes effortlessly. Create, edit, and delete recipes via intuitive UIs without ever touching a config file.
body:
🔥 FurnaceEditor | The Ultimate Smelting Solution



![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Paper%20%7C%20Spigot%20%7C%20Purpur-orange)

![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21%2B-blue)

![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green)



**FurnaceEditor** is the companion plugin to [CraftEditor](https://modrinth.com/project/crafteditor). It allows server administrators to create, edit, and delete smelting and cooking recipes directly in-game, without ever opening a configuration file.



---



## ✨ Why choose FurnaceEditor?



Unlike other plugins, **FurnaceEditor** features a step-by-step creation "Wizard" that is incredibly easy to use:



* **⚡ Multi-Workstation Support**: Create recipes for Furnaces, Smokers, Blast Furnaces, Campfires, and Soul Campfires.

* **🕒 Precise Time Control**: Set cooking times down to the exact second (or tick) via an intuitive clock GUI.

* **🛠️ Full NBT Support**: Use items with custom names, special enchantments, or unique lore as both ingredients and results.

* **🚫 Vanilla Disabler**: Disable default Minecraft recipes with a single click using `/fe disable` to balance your server's economy.

* **📦 Optimized for Folia & Paper**: Lightweight, asynchronous code ensures your server stays lag-free.
